name: Allopenna Magnuson & Tanenhaus (1998)
citation: Allopenna, P. D., Magnuson, J. S., & Tanenhaus, M. K. (1998). Tracking the time course of spoken word recognition using eye movements: Evidence for continuous mapping models. Journal of Memory and Language, 38(4), 419-439.
notes: Foundational VWP study (beaker/beetle/speaker/carriage). Stimulus items described in paper; not packaged as a downloadable set.

name: Altmann & Kamide (1999)
citation: Altmann, G. T. M., & Kamide, Y. (1999). Incremental interpretation at verbs: Restricting the domain of subsequent reference. Cognition, 73(3), 247-264.
notes: Classic anticipatory-looks study (the boy will eat the cake). Semi-realistic scenes rather than 4-object arrays.

name: BOSS — Bank of Standardized Stimuli
citation: Brodeur, M. B., Dionne-Dostie, E., Montreuil, T., & Lepage, M. (2010/2014). The Bank of Standardized Stimuli (BOSS). PLoS ONE.
notes: Not VWP-specific but the most common normed object-photo source for building VWP displays. Used in the OpenSesame VWP tutorial.

name: OpenSesame VWP Tutorial Project
citation: Mathôt, S. et al. OpenSesame visual-world paradigm tutorial.
notes: Complete runnable VWP experiment + stimuli, built for teaching. Good template for experiment structure.

name: Referential Contrast Effect (VWP eye-tracking)
citation: OSF project: Referential contrast effect: Visual World paradigm with eye-tracking.
notes: Study repository including eye-tracking data. Verify contents and license before reuse.

name: Eye-movement Suppression in the VWP
citation: Eye-movement suppression in the visual world paradigm. Open Mind, 8, 1012-1036 (2024). doi:10.1162/opmi_a_00157
notes: Data + analysis scripts. Methods-focused; useful for analysis pipelines more than stimuli.
